title: Restrictions
description: Easily manage player actions and interactions on your server with Restrictions!
body:
- **Permission-Based Control**
Restrict player actions like breaking blocks, placing blocks, interacting with GUIs, using tools, and equipping armor based on permissions.

- **Customizable Feedback**
Tailor the messages players see when an action is restricted, with support for ActionBar, Title, and Chat messages.

- **Biome and World Conditions**
Limit specific actions to certain biomes or worlds to add depth and thematic gameplay mechanics.

- **Dynamic Reloading**
Reload the plugin configuration instantly using a simple command—no server restarts required.

- **Lightweight and Performance-Friendly**
Designed to have minimal impact on server performance, even with extensive configurations.

**Commands**
/restrictionsreload
- Description: Reloads the plugin configuration without restarting the server.
Permission: restrictions.reload
